reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message and confirmed the figure: the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats. That thread is the only place the figure is recorded for now.

I couldn't save it to gbrain. The brain refused my request and read nothing, because the bot's access token isn't linked to any member. An admin on the brain host needs to fix that before I can save anything there. The brain's error message suggests one of two commands:

- To link the token to one member: `gbrain auth rescope --token <bot token> --member <MEMBER>`
- To let the bot act for several people: the same command with `--may-act-for <members>`

I didn't run either because they're host-admin decisions.
